1 (sh t 4)

Mr. Jacques Schmidt, whose office is located
at 34 Avenue Edward VII with the view to
securing transit for this rice through the
Japanese Military lines. This arrangement
failed to materialise.
(2) About three weeks ago, a wine shop owner in
Hongkew District approached me through one of
my relatives, requesting me to arrange for the
transportation of a quantity of wine from
Hongkew District. I contacted a Frenchman,
one Mr. Marcel Greffier, to arrange for the
removal of the wine, this arrangement also
fell through owing to differences arising over
the rate of commission to be paid.
(3) My great-uncle, one Zee Kwei-chi, is a clerical
assistant in the Japanese Consulate General
and has been residing with me for approximately
the past month. These circumstances may there-
fore have prompted the bomb throwing.

Today, I have twice received telephone calls
which when answered failed to bring any res-
ponse. A similar occurrence happened about a
fortnight ago.
I have never indulged in any pro-Japanese
activities nor have I had personal dealings
with the Japanese.
At present I am winding up my affairs prior
to my departure from Shanghai in order to
proceed to Anhwei to find employment.

Mr. Chung Yung-huan however refused to divulge any
further information.

Further enquiries in the vicinity of the offence
failed to obtain any witnesses or information and those
concerned allege that they did not observe the person
who threw the hand grenade.

The nearest C.P.Cs. to the scene of the offence were
C.P.Cs. 2014 & 2040, walking 10A beat, I Section. These
police officers were at the time of the crime being com-
mitted, at corner of Tatung & Sian Roads, about 140 yds
away, consequently they were not aware of the occurrence
pages.zh:
1 (第 4 页)

雅克·施密特 (Jacques Schmidt) 先生，其办公室位于爱多亚路 (Avenue Edward VII) 34 号，旨在为这批大米通过日军防线安排运输。该安排未能实现。
(2) 约三周前，虹口区一名酒铺老板通过我的一位亲戚与我联系，请求我安排从虹口区运输一批葡萄酒。我联系了一位法国人马塞尔·格雷菲耶 (Marcel Greffier) 先生以安排运走葡萄酒，但因在佣金费率上产生分歧，该安排也告吹。
(3) 我的叔祖父季桂芝 (Zee Kwei-chi，音译) 是日本总领事馆的一名文书助理，过去一个月左右一直与我同住。因此，这些情况可能引发了投掷炸弹事件。

今天，我两次接到电话，但接听后对方没有任何回应。大约两周前也发生过类似情况。
我从未参与任何亲日活动，也未与日本人有过私人往来。
目前，我正在处理事务，准备离开上海前往安徽求职。

然而，钟永焕 (Chung Yung-huan，音译) 先生拒绝透露更多情报。

在案发地点附近的进一步调查未能找到任何证人或情报，相关人员声称他们未观察到投掷手榴弹的人。

离案发现场最近的巡捕是 I 段 10A 巡逻区的巡捕 2014 号和 2040 号。案发时，这些警员正在大同路与西康路路口，距离约 140 码，因此他们并未察觉此事发生

File No. ....
Central Station,
REPORT
Date May 5th. 19 39.

Subject. Reports re shipping

Made by. Inspector Lees Forwarded by. [Signature] C.

Sir,

Italian Vessel refused entry to Ningpo.

The S.S. "Tembien", property of the "Italo Chinese River Navigation Company", 163 Canton Road, (This Company is owned by Mr. Yu Ya Ching), chartered to the Ningpo Association, but flying the Italian flag, sailed from the Public Garden Pontoons during the evening of the 1-5-39, with Chinese doctors, nurses and medical supplies on board, booked to Ningpo.

During the early morning of the 2-5-39, whilst the vessel was on its way to Ningpo, it was intercepted by Japanese Naval vessels and the vessel was searched. After the Japanese Naval Authorities had completed their searching, they ordered the vessel to return to Shanghai, which it did on the 3-5-39, and tied up to Buoys 20 - 21 in the Whangpoo River off The French Bund.

Negotiations are at present proceeding between the Japanese and Italian Authorities regarding this vessel and its purpose in proceeding to Ningpo, with doctors, nurses and medical supplies.

Discrimination against Third National Shipping.

日期 1939 年 5 月 5 日。

主题：关于航运的报告

呈报人：利斯 (Lees) 督察 转发人：[签名] C.

先生，

意大利船只被拒绝进入宁波。

“天便”号轮船 (S.S. "Tembien")，系“意中内河航运公司” (Italo Chinese River Navigation Company) 所有，地址广东路 163 号（该公司由虞洽卿先生拥有），包租给宁波同乡会，但悬挂意大利国旗，于 1939 年 5 月 1 日晚从公家花园码头启航，船上载有中国医生、护士和医疗物资，目的地为宁波。

1939 年 5 月 2 日凌晨，当该船驶往宁波途中时，被日本海军舰艇拦截并进行搜查。日本海军当局完成搜查后，命令该船返回上海。该船遂于 1939 年 5 月 3 日返回，并停靠在法外滩外黄浦江的 20-21 号浮筒处。

目前，日本和意大利当局正就该船及其携带医生、护士和医疗物资前往宁波的目的进行谈判。

对第三国航运的歧视。

“赫尔塔”号轮船 (S.S. "Hertha")，系“德国远东轮船公司” (German Far East Steamship Company) 所有，地址爱多亚路 147 号，于 1939 年 5 月 2 日最后一次访问江苏省新港 (Sinkiang，音译) 时，被日本海军当局登船检查，并且

taxes :-
Pigs :- $2.00 tax per head.
Cows :- $5.00 tax per head.
Eggs :- $3.00 tax per thousand.
They were also informed that these taxes are
only imposed on vessels of third nationals and if they
transport their goods on Japanese vessels, no taxes
whatsoever will be imposed, also that all Japanese
vessels will load first, taking capacity loads and
that vessels of third nationals must wait one hour
after all Japanese vessels have left the port, before
they will be permitted to load.
This action of the Japanese Authorities will
seriously effect German and British Shipping at this
port.

〔此处转录不清〕 正在征收以下
税款：
猪：每头征税 2.00 元。
牛：每头征税 5.00 元。
鸡蛋：每千枚征税 3.00 元。
他们还被告知，这些税款仅针对第三国国民的船只征收，如果他们将货物装载在日本船只上，则不征收任何税款；此外，所有日本船只将优先装载，满载为止，而第三国国民的船只必须在所有日本船只离港一小时后，方获准装载。
日本当局的这一行动将严重影响本港的德国和英国航运业。

（批注：归档）
（批注：警务处长致特务科副主任 5月4日）

此致，
敬礼。
